changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: create or alter function metrics.RoundScoreItem(@Val decimal(32,16), @Digits Int) returns decimal(32,16) AS begin return case when Abs(@Val - Round(@Val, @Digits, 1)) * Power(10, @Digits+1) = 5 then Round(@Val, @Digits, Convert(int, (select rnd From RandomNumber))) else Round(@Val, @Digits) end end
